label: Load a folder of Markdown files into Pinecone for RAG
description: Takes all files in the directory set in the Docs directory input and uploads them to a vector database.

tasks.label: Filesystem
tasks.description: Lists every file in the folder set in the Docs directory input, including subfolders. Each entry's relative path is used to read the file.
tasks.name: filesystem_1

tasks.description: Goes through each file found in the folder and loads it into Pinecone, one file at a time.
tasks.name: loop_1

iteratee.label: Filesystem
iteratee.description: Reads the current file from disk, combining the Docs directory input with the file's relative path.
iteratee.name: filesystem_2

iteratee.label: Pinecone
iteratee.description: Splits the file as a Markdown document, embeds it and stores it in your Pinecone index, so a RAG agent can search it later. Needs a Pinecone connection and index.
iteratee.name: pinecone_1
